source.note: L'Oréal files in France and is not in SEC EDGAR. Figures are as reported in euros; no USD conversion is applied because the margin is a ratio.

GROUP-WIDE and therefore the weakest comparator in this table. LVMH's gross margin is dominated by Fashion & Leather Goods; Perfumes & Cosmetics is a separate reporting segment whose gross margin LVMH does not break out. FY2024 is used because the published key-figures table does not yet carry a FY2025 gross margin line.

Revlon filed for Chapter 11 in 2022 and emerged in 2023 as a private company. It no longer files a 10-K, so no current primary gross-margin figure exists. Revlon ColorStay stays in the ingredient corpus (its FDA label is filed like any other) but is excluded from the margin comparison.
